name: Tejnaksh Healthcare Limited
summary: Tejnaksh Healthcare Limited provides hospital and healthcare services in India. The company offers health care services through urology clinics, urology hospitals, and dental super specialty clinics; and operates multi-specialty hospitals, super-specialty hospitals, education institutes, pathology labs, super specialty training institutes, simulation institutes, and stone analysis labs. It also sells healthcare equipment, medical goods, and pharmaceuticals. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of inpatient and outpatient services. Tejnaksh Healthcare Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Dhule, India.
